project_type: Next.js 15 App Router PWA (Heula) — intermittent fasting, fully offline, on-device, no backend, no account, no network calls for data; mobile-first iOS styling. EXISTING, building, approved app — extend in place, do NOT rebuild.
build_system: npm + Next.js 15.5.4. `npm run build` runs `next build` and generates the Serwist service worker. QUIRK: the SW is disabled in `next dev`; offline/install/A2HS behavior is only observable via `npm run build` then `npm start`.
test_framework: Vitest 3.2.4, environment node (no window/navigator — exercises SSR-safe branches), include pattern src/**/*.test.ts, @ alias -> ./src (vitest.config.ts). Pure-logic unit tests only; DOM/IndexedDB/canvas flows are checked manually (README smoke checklist). The no-emoji scan src/lib/__tests__/no-emoji.test.ts scans ALL of src + README, grows one test per new file, and FAILS on ANY emoji.
verification_instructions: After every change: `npx tsc --noEmit` (strict, no any), then `npx vitest run` (BASELINE 185 tests across 8 files must stay green and only grow — includes the no-emoji scan), then `npm run build` (production build + SW). Run `npm run lint` when touching many files or any import boundary (eslint bans react-icons outside io5, and bans dexie/dexie-react-hooks/@/db from non-client modules). Scope a single lib test e.g. `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/weight.test.ts`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next build generates .next and the Serwist service worker (public/sw.js) — not hand-edited, not committed source. No hand-maintained snapshots. null.
environment_constraints: Local repo on branch main, NO worktree, clean tree at HEAD e2c5b65. Edit in place. Each FEAT commits ONLY the files it touches, by name (never `git add -A`/`git add .`). Never push. DO NOT TOUCH (empty diff vs HEAD required): src/components/layout/Chrome.tsx, src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx, src/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx — the shell + floating pill BottomTabBar wiring is FINAL. New screens live UNDER the four tab routes (/, /history, /stats, /profile); nested routes like /stats/berat match Chrome.isTabRoute via startsWith so the tab bar shows unchanged. Do NOT disturb the SW/notifications subsystem (src/app/sw.ts, src/lib/notifications.ts, src/features/settings/ReminderSettings.tsx) except the A2HS feature may ADD to src/lib/pwa.ts + new components without breaking the existing iOS install hint.
contribution_requirements: ZERO EMOJI anywhere in src + README (vitest scan). ALL icons via the single choke-point src/components/ui/Icon.tsx (imports ONLY react-icons/io5, map asserted `satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`): to add an icon, add the key to the IconKey union in src/types/index.ts AND add the mapping in Icon.tsx with a VERIFIED io5 name — never import react-icons elsewhere, never use lucide. ALL user-facing copy lives in the typed `copy` object (+ GOAL_LABELS) in src/lib/copy.ts, Indonesian casual Gojek voice, no emoji. Pure/derivable domain logic in framework-free src/lib (NO React imports, NO @/db import); DB access in src/db; UI in src/features + src/components reusing primitives + iOS tokens. No any. SSR-safe (guard window/navigator/Notification/serviceWorker/canvas; client-only). Dexie migrations ADDITIVE only (bump version, add stores/fields, never wipe). Guard reads of possibly-missing fields on older persisted/profiling/session data.
key_patterns: VERIFIED-PRESENT io5 names for new icons (confirmed via `require('react-icons/io5')` during exploration): IoScaleOutline, IoTrendingUp, IoTrendingDown, IoAddOutline, IoSparklesOutline, IoTrophyOutline, IoMedalOutline, IoRibbonOutline, IoLockClosedOutline, IoShareSocialOutline, IoBatteryChargingOutline, IoBatteryDeadOutline, IoRemoveCircleOutline, IoFastFoodOutline, IoHourglassOutline, IoBulbOutline. Pure libs (recommendation.ts, stats.ts, bmi.ts, stages.ts, methods.ts, timer.ts) are React-free, import types from @/types + copy from @/lib/copy, and INJECT `now` for determinism (never call Date.now() in core). RECOMMENDATION SAFETY INVARIANTS (must stay intact): recommendMethod R1 heavy-exercise guard returns 14:10 + mandatory non-null warning for ANY goal BEFORE any BMI/history logic; canOfferAggressive(answers) is the SOLE gate for 20:4/omad (only as alternatives, only weight_loss + exerciseState none/light); 20:4/omad are NEVER the primary method; applyBmiAdjustment only sharpens/softens, never adds aggressive methods. The new adaptive layer must respect ALL of these: method ladder for step-ups is 14:10->16:8->18:6, capped at 18:6 unless canOfferAggressive, and never auto-applies a method. Dexie: src/db/db.ts is a top-level singleton (HeulaDB extends Dexie), v1 stores sessions '++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId'. src/db/sessions.ts wraps every call in try/catch with dev console.error and returns safe values. Store: Zustand 5 persisted to localStorage key heula-store with a partialize whitelist (onboarded, profiling, chosenMethod, customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme, reminders, activeFast) + transient `hydrated` flag NEVER persisted; onRehydrateStorage sets hydrated + re-arms end reminder. stopFast currently returns void and writes via sessions.add (FEAT-004 changes it to return the new id). UI primitives: Button (min-h-12 variants, motion whileTap), Card (rounded-card border bg-surface shadow-card), Sheet (motion slide-up bottom sheet), Segmented (iOS segmented, motion layoutId highlight), ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, Spinner, Icon. WeeklyBarChart.tsx is the reference div-based chart (scale bars vs max, NO charting lib) — follow it for weight/achievement visuals. Dexie live data via useLiveQuery from dexie-react-hooks in 'use client' components. Tailwind v4 CSS-first tokens in src/app/globals.css: brand/brand-fg/brand-soft (emerald #0e9f6e), bg/surface/surface-2/border/content/content-muted (light :root + .dark), danger, rounded-card/control/pill; dark via @custom-variant dark; safe-top/safe-bottom @utility.
